module: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 (flash/PSRAM variant not read from physical module; README states 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM)
verification_note: Traced from the upstream schematic and cross-checked against the upstream example. No physical board has been inspected or powered. Do not treat any value here as bench-validated.

display.native_resolution: 240x320 portrait; landscape rotation not yet validated

miso.note: LCD SDO reaches GPIO12 through diode D4; example does not define TFT_MISO

backlight.note: Drives S8050 Q3 low-side switch; active level assumed high, not bench-tested

penirq.note: Example polls and does not use PENIRQ

sd.interface: SDIO 1-bit (DAT1, DAT2 and CD/DAT3 only have 10 kOhm pull-ups, no GPIO)

expansion.voltage: Headers carry +3V3 and GND only; 5 V (VBUS after diode D3) is not on a header

J1.note: Upstream example uses GPIO5=SDA, GPIO4=SCL for an external I2C sensor

unrouted_gpios.note: Only dangling net labels at the module (CSI_*, IO38/SCL, IO39/SDA, IO40, IO47/SPI_NCS2); no connector or pad shown. Not physically accessible per schematic.

power.regulator: LD1117 3.3 V from VBUS via 1N4148WS diode D3
power.budget_note: LD1117 headroom for an external amplifier is unmeasured. The owner has wired MAX98357A Vin to header +3V3 (user-reported); keep digital output capped and measure current/brownout before raising volume (H03).

audio.status: External INMP441 mic + MAX98357A amp wired by the owner (user-reported wiring table, 2026-11-04). Not bench-verified: no scope capture, current or acoustic level measurement yet (H03).

wiring_evidence.description: Owner-supplied wiring table. Shared I2S clocks: INMP441 SCK + MAX98357A BCLK -> GPIO4 (J1); INMP441 WS + MAX98357A LRC -> GPIO5 (J1); INMP441 SD -> GPIO6 (J2); MAX98357A DIN -> GPIO7 (J2). INMP441 VDD 3V3, L/R -> GND (left slot). MAX98357A Vin 3V3, GAIN unconnected (~9 dB), SD -> 3V3 via 10 kOhm (always enabled; selects left channel per datasheet SD_MODE thresholds, so firmware writes the same sample to both slots).

audio.amp_shutdown: No GPIO: SD_MODE hard-wired high through 10 kOhm (amp always enabled). Startup pop and mute behaviour rely on I2S clocks being idle until firmware starts them.
